parameters.name: QueryTime
parameters.description: The point of time to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-online-user-num --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --query-time 2018-12-27T13:09:21Z --region cn-hangzhou
